summary: This Form 6-K filed by Globus Maritime Ltd reports the company's financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains standard quarterly earnings disclosure including revenue of $12.2 million, adjusted EBITDA of $6.2 million, and fleet operational details. There is no announcement of any transaction, special event, or corporate action. The document is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation filing.
